description: List the guests waiting for a table, oldest first. Without date: today's queue, the entries with no date or today's date. With date (YYYY-MM-DD): the waiting entries guests made through the public waitlist for that date, plus today's queue when it is today. Each entry carries date (null for the same-day queue), windowStart, windowEnd and source (staff or widget). waitlist.seat works only for an entry of today or with no date; for a future date, book with reservation.create and then remove the entry with waitlist.cancel.

date.description: A local date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit it for today's queue.

name: waitlist.list
title: List waitlist
